segments.ko: Optimizing image-processing performance

segments.source: **Framework**: Accelerate

segments.source: Improve your app’s performance by converting image buffer formats from interleaved to planar.
segments.ko: Improve your app’s performance by converting image buffer formats from interleaved to planar.

segments.source: Overview
segments.ko: Overview

segments.source: The vImage library operates on image data with two memory layouts:
segments.ko: The vImage library operates on image data with two memory layouts:

segments.source: **Interleaved** stores each pixel’s color data consecutively in a single buffer.
segments.ko: **Interleaved** stores each pixel’s color data consecutively in a single buffer.

segments.source: For example, the data that describes a 4-channel image (red, green, blue, and alpha) would be stored as RGBARGBARGBA…
segments.ko: For example, the data that describes a 4-channel image (red, green, blue, and alpha) would be stored as RGBARGBARGBA…

segments.source: **Planar** stores each color channel in separate buffers.
segments.ko: **Planar** stores each color channel in separate buffers.

segments.source: For example, a 4-channel image would be stored as four individual buffers containing red, green, blue, and alpha data.
segments.ko: For example, a 4-channel image would be stored as four individual buffers containing red, green, blue, and alpha data.

segments.source: ![A diagram showing how the color information for each pixel in an image is stored in interleaved and planar buffers.](https://docs-assets.developer.apple.com/published/9ca5720cecfccf9a40e29dcb8dfb8134/media-3023512%402x.png)
segments.ko: ![A diagram showing how the color information for each pixel in an image is stored in interleaved and planar buffers.](https://docs-assets.developer.apple.com/published/9ca5720cecfccf9a40e29dcb8dfb8134/media-3023512%402x.png)

segments.source: Because many vImage functions operate on a single color channel at a time — by converting an interleaved buffer to planar buffers — you can often improve your app’s performance by doing this conversion manually.
segments.ko: Because many vImage functions operate on a single color channel at a time — by converting an interleaved buffer to planar buffers — you can often improve your app’s performance by doing this conversion manually.

segments.source: However, most vImage functions are available in both the interleaved and planar variants, so before you do the conversion, try both to see which works better in your context.
segments.ko: However, most vImage functions are available in both the interleaved and planar variants, so before you do the conversion, try both to see which works better in your context.

segments.source: In some cases, you may not want to apply a vImage operation to all four channels of an image.
segments.ko: In some cases, you may not want to apply a vImage operation to all four channels of an image.

segments.source: For example, you may know beforehand that the alpha channel is irrelevant in the images that you’re dealing with, or perhaps all of your images are grayscale and you need to operate on only one channel.
segments.ko: For example, you may know beforehand that the alpha channel is irrelevant in the images that you’re dealing with, or perhaps all of your images are grayscale and you need to operate on only one channel.

segments.source: Using planar formats makes it possible to isolate and work with only the channels you need.
segments.ko: Using planar formats makes it possible to isolate and work with only the channels you need.

segments.source: Review Interleaved Performance
segments.ko: Review Interleaved Performance

segments.source: Typically, your source imagery is in interleaved format, and your default option will be to use the interleaved variant of a vImage function.
segments.ko: Typically, your source imagery is in interleaved format, and your default option will be to use the interleaved variant of a vImage function.

segments.source: For example, the following code scales a Core Graphics image to one tenth of its original size.
segments.ko: For example, the following code scales a Core Graphics image to one tenth of its original size.

segments.source: Note that the 4-channel, 8-bit-per-channel interleaved pixel buffer [`scale(destination:)`](vimage/pixelbuffer/scale(destination:)-5euvc.md) function calls [`vImageScale_ARGB8888(_:_:_:_:)`](vimagescale_argb8888(_:_:_:_:).md).
segments.ko: Note that the 4-channel, 8-bit-per-channel interleaved pixel buffer [`scale(destination:)`](vimage/pixelbuffer/scale(destination:)-5euvc.md) function calls [`vImageScale_ARGB8888(_:_:_:_:)`](vimagescale_argb8888(_:_:_:_:).md).

segments.source:
```swift
var cgImageFormat = vImage_CGImageFormat(
    bitsPerComponent: 8,
    bitsPerPixel: 8 * 4,
    colorSpace: CGColorSpaceCreateDeviceRGB(),
    bitmapInfo: CGBitmapInfo(rawValue:
                                CGImageAlphaInfo.noneSkipLast.rawValue))!

let sourceBuffer = try vImage.PixelBuffer(cgImage: sourceImage,
                                          cgImageFormat: &cgImageFormat,
                                          pixelFormat: vImage.Interleaved8x4.self)

let destinationBuffer = vImage.PixelBuffer(size: .init(width: sourceBuffer.width / 10,
                                                       height: sourceBuffer.height / 10),
                                           pixelFormat: vImage.Interleaved8x4.self)

let time = ContinuousClock().measure {
    sourceBuffer.scale(destination: destinationBuffer)
}
```

segments.source: Convert an Interleaved Source Buffer to Planar Buffers
segments.ko: Convert an Interleaved Source Buffer to Planar Buffers

segments.source: The pixel buffer [`init(cgImage:cgImageFormat:pixelFormat:)`](vimage/pixelbuffer/init(cgimage:cgimageformat:pixelformat:).md) initializer and the vImage buffer [`vImageBuffer_InitWithCGImage(_:_:_:_:_:)`](vimagebuffer_initwithcgimage(_:_:_:_:_:).md) function both populate a buffer based on the properties of a [`vImage_CGImageFormat`](vimage_cgimageformat.md) structure.
segments.ko: The pixel buffer [`init(cgImage:cgImageFormat:pixelFormat:)`](vimage/pixelbuffer/init(cgimage:cgimageformat:pixelformat:).md) initializer and the vImage buffer [`vImageBuffer_InitWithCGImage(_:_:_:_:_:)`](vimagebuffer_initwithcgimage(_:_:_:_:_:).md) function both populate a buffer based on the properties of a [`vImage_CGImageFormat`](vimage_cgimageformat.md) structure.

segments.source: For example, the following code creates an interleaved 3-channel, 8-bit-per-channel [`vImage.PixelBuffer`](vimage/pixelbuffer.md) structure from the source Core Graphics image.
segments.ko: For example, the following code creates an interleaved 3-channel, 8-bit-per-channel [`vImage.PixelBuffer`](vimage/pixelbuffer.md) structure from the source Core Graphics image.

segments.source: The code calls [`deinterleave(destination:)`](vimage/pixelbuffer/deinterleave(destination:)-hrhz.md) to deinterleave the image data and populate the individual red, green, and blue planar pixel buffers.
segments.ko: The code calls [`deinterleave(destination:)`](vimage/pixelbuffer/deinterleave(destination:)-hrhz.md) to deinterleave the image data and populate the individual red, green, and blue planar pixel buffers.

segments.source:
```swift
var cgImageFormat = vImage_CGImageFormat(
    bitsPerComponent: 8,
    bitsPerPixel: 8 * 3,
    colorSpace: CGColorSpaceCreateDeviceRGB(),
    bitmapInfo: CGBitmapInfo(rawValue:
                                CGImageAlphaInfo.none.rawValue))!

let sourceBuffer = try vImage.PixelBuffer(cgImage: sourceImage,
                                          cgImageFormat: &cgImageFormat,
                                          pixelFormat: vImage.Interleaved8x3.self)
let sourceRedBuffer = vImage.PixelBuffer(size: sourceBuffer.size,
                                         pixelFormat: vImage.Planar8.self)
let sourceGreenBuffer = vImage.PixelBuffer(size: sourceBuffer.size,
                                           pixelFormat: vImage.Planar8.self)
let sourceBlueBuffer = vImage.PixelBuffer(size: sourceBuffer.size,
                                          pixelFormat: vImage.Planar8.self)

sourceBuffer.deinterleave(planarDestinationBuffers: [sourceRedBuffer,
                                                     sourceGreenBuffer,
                                                     sourceBlueBuffer])
```

```swift
sourceBuffer.deinterleave(planarDestinationBuffers: [sourceRedBuffer,
                                                     sourceGreenBuffer,
                                                     sourceBlueBuffer])
```
